model: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Code subagent, general-purpose, clean context)

items.quote: Permission: write needs `MANAGE_PRODUCTS` (existing mutations); read public (as `description`).
Dashboard: input on product create+update pages; field on product translations page.
Storefront: PDP shows labeled line under description; translated value w/ fallback to base; hidden when empty.
Gates: unit/API tests + lint + typecheck + codegen in 3 repos; manual check on local stack.
Test data: happy `"Keep refrigerated at 2–8 °C"`, `"Store in a cool, dry place"`
Out of scope: cart/checkout/emails, search index/filters, e2e, new webhook events, rich text. ... `products/[slug]/page.tsx`: render under description. Only this page.
Migration: add column w/ default "" ... Reverse migration = drop column (reversible, no data backfill).
Also in scope: product webhook payloads (legacy `PRODUCT_FIELDS`; subscription payloads follow the type) and product CSV export. Not needed: filter, search, CSV import.
Permission: write needs `MANAGE_PRODUCTS` (existing mutations); read public (as `description`).

unresolved_contradictions.quote_a: Field nullable-safe for old clients (`String!`, default "").
input TranslationInput { storageConditions: String }   # SHARED input (no type rename → productTranslate/productBulkTranslate non-breaking)

reason: The requirements settle all 13 checklist items. Each one has a concrete decision on model placement, length, translation, display scope, migration, webhooks, CSV and permissions. No contradictions were planted, but the spec contradicts itself in two places: it calls the GraphQL type both `String!` and nullable `String`, and it names both the shared `TranslationInput` and a separate `ProductTranslationInput` as the translation input.
